## `casim` — the package layer (CLI, suite, io, analysis, viz, gui)

| Module | Summary |
|--------|---------|
| `analysis/` | casim.analysis — post-run analysis over result JSON. |
| `baselines.py` | Numeric drift detection for result artifacts — roadmap P1.2. |
| `cli.py` | casim.cli — command-line entry point. |
| `constants/` | casim.constants — the single **source of truth** for the model's constants. |
| `fields/` | casim.fields — field sectors, organised by the F91 propagator classification. |
| `gravity/` | casim.gravity — F64 dielectric gravity. |
| `gui/` | casim.gui — interactive viewer (roadmap Phase E), grown from live_display.py. |
| `index/` | casim.index — CASIM owns the indexes (roadmap **C8**). |
| `io/` | casim.io — scenario loading and result writing. |
| `lattice/` | casim.lattice — lattice substrate & FFT backend (re-exports legacy kernels). |
| `numerics/` | casim.numerics — the ONLY numerics surface. Roadmap C1, decision D8. |
| `particles/` | casim.particles — typed particles stacked on the lattice. |
| `suite/` | casim.suite — the unified, user-run, grouped test suite. |
| `tests/` | casim.tests — the test registry (roadmap C7, decision **D9**). |
| `verify.py` | casim.verify — canonical fidelity & exactness checks. |
| `viz/` | casim.viz — static figure helpers (re-exports legacy viz, tick_heatmap). |
